**Source** [Rusthenge](/Sources.aspx?ID=215) pg. 49 **Complexity** Simple Rivulets of water begin to run from the circle of stones to gather in a growing puddle at the center. --- **Stealth** DC 20 (trained) **Disable** DC 20 [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) (expert) to rub out the hidden runes on the ceiling, or [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78) (2nd level, [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) DC 18) to counteract the trap **Spherical Deluge** ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [conjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=33), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165)) **Trigger** A creature enters the area south of the ring of stones marked on the map; **Effect** A deluge of water rises up from the ring of stones, then flows forcefully down the passageway to drain into the pit at area **F1b**. Large and smaller creatures in the water's path must attempt a DC 20 Fortitude save. The rushing waters vanish instantly upon striking the pit floor, but do leave everything down there sopping wet. **Critical Success** The creature withstands the force of the rushing waters and is unaffected.
**Success** The creature takes 1d10 bludgeoning damage as the rushing waters slam them into a cave wall.
**Failure** The creature is knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) by the rushing waters, takes 1d10+6 bludgeoning damage, and is [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) by the water to the spiky pit trap and triggers the trap.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature can't attempt to [Grab an Edge](/Actions.aspx?ID=95) if they fall into the [spiky pit trap](/Hazards.aspx?ID=424). --- **Reset** The magic rejuvenates over 10 minutes, after which it is recharged and ready to activate again.
